instructions:
**Running and saving examples**

1. Press **Run** beside a code example. Its output appears immediately below it. You can run any example first.
2. After changing the code, press **Run** again to update its output.
3. **Reset example** restores that example's original code and clears its result. Other examples stay as they are.

Code edits save in this browser as you type, even before you run them. After a refresh, your saved code returns; press **Run** to produce its result again. Choose **Download code** to keep a separate copy. The answer boxes at the end save separately as you type.

<details><summary>Working offline</summary>

Choose **Download full course** on the [contents page](https://snowch.github.io/metadata-systems/) while connected to the internet. Once the download finishes, you can open and run the course offline.

</details>
